summary: The first stop is the inventory item-action takeoff at step 4. C queues ia_dotakeoff() with the selected cloak letter; ia_dotakeoff() sets gi.item_action_in_progress around dotakeoff(), which forces getobj() to consume that letter and lets equip_ok() follow its item-action removal branch. JavaScript queues the alttakeoff row but has no ia_dotakeoff() implementation or dispatch and omits the flag checks in dotakeoff() and equip_ok(). The C recording shows the cloak removed at step 4 (AC 9 to 10). The later bare-handed Nurse AD_HEAL attack occurs only after that setup and is downstream of the present stop.

source.branch: When itemactions() selects IA_TAKEOFF_OBJ for worn armor, itemactions_pushkeys() queues ia_dotakeoff() and the selected inventory letter. ia_dotakeoff() sets gi.item_action_in_progress while dotakeoff() selects and removes the item; the flag forces the getobj() selection and makes equip_ok() bypass its inaccessible-equipment filter.
callers: cmd.c:rhack() dispatches the queued CQ_CANNED function pointer

evidence: C source: nethack-c/upstream/src/iactions.c:230-232 queues ia_dotakeoff and the selected inventory letter for IA_TAKEOFF_OBJ; itemactions():703-707 calls itemactions_pushkeys after menu selection.

C source: nethack-c/upstream/src/do_wear.c:1831-1854 makes dotakeoff call getobj when gi.item_action_in_progress is true; 1862-1869 shows ia_dotakeoff setting and clearing that flag around dotakeoff; 3439-3442 makes equip_ok bypass inaccessible-equipment filtering while the flag is set.

Current JavaScript path: js/iactions.js:332-335 queues extcmdRow("alttakeoff") plus the item letter, and js/extcmdlist_data.js:211 binds that row to ia_dotakeoff. js/do_wear.js:2886-2889 and 3792-3812 document that the wrapper is unported and dotakeoff omits the flag condition; `rg -n "ia_dotakeoff" js/do_wear.js js/cmd.js` finds no implementation or queued-handler dispatch.

Saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261003003219-v20.json and the queue row report 4 of 113 screens matched, then a stop at step 4 with the repeated-command boundary error. The recorded C segment challenges/cases/v20/nurse-heals-wizard-after-cloak-removal-v20-menu-order-corrected.session.json has input T at segment 0 step 4 and shows the cloak-removal message with AC changing from 9 to 10.

The prior source clarification in .cache/v20-admission-overlap-review.json places Nurse appearance at step 32 and bare-handed Nurse care hits at step 35, reaching uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_heal. This is a later C effect after cloak removal; it does not own the first stop at step 4.
